payload.title: Choose a domain for the public site
payload.description: Until then the site answers on the CloudFront distribution's *.cloudfront.net name. Add `aliases` and `acm` (hosted zone) to `backend.publication.distribution` in `papyrus.config.ts`, set `publication.siteUrl` in `web/site-config.json` (canonical links, sitemap, RSS), and add the CMS OAuth redirect URLs.
